shots.name: analytics-slice
shots.eval: document.querySelector('button[data-go="analytics"]').click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.analytics-range button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '7 d').click(); var hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chart-hit')].sort((a, b) => b.dataset.v - a.dataset.v)[0]; hit.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true }));

shots.name: session-jump
shots.eval: document.querySelector('button[data-go="sessions"]').click(); document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="harbor"]').click(); var phone = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 760px)').matches; if (phone) { window.scrollBy(0, -320); } else { document.querySelector('#main').scrollTop -= 320; }

shots.name: thinking-unmasked
shots.eval: document.querySelector('button[data-go="sessions"]').click(); document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="harbor"]').click(); var b = document.querySelector('.think'); if (b) { b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); b.click(); }

shots.name: thinking-masked
shots.eval: document.querySelector('button[data-go="sessions"]').click(); document.querySelector('.nrow[data-id="principal"]').click(); var m = document.querySelector('.think-masked'); if (m) m.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

shots.name: sessions-no-match
shots.eval: mock.go({ v: 'sessions' }); var i = document.querySelector('#sq'); i.value = 'zeppelin'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
